title: Inventory
deltaHelp: Enter a signed whole number: positive adds stock, negative removes it.
invalidDelta: Enter a nonzero whole quantity within the supported range.
invalidDirection: This reason requires a quantity change in the correct direction.
alreadyInitialized: Initial stock is allowed only before the first movement.
insufficientStock: This adjustment would make stock negative.
stockOverflow: This adjustment would exceed the stock limit.
retireStock: Set remaining stock to zero with a recorded adjustment before retiring this variant.
